notes: Four rounds, two of them DISAGREE, and the verdict changed direction each time. All four are recorded here because the reasons the verdict flipped are the substance; a record carrying only the final AGREE would throw them away. ROUND 1 (b09d7d0) DISAGREE, three defects: the directive-8 fix stopped scripts/lwb_check_env_leak.py printing a matched private name into a public Actions log, but scripts/lwb_handoff.py:251 still did exactly that -- in the file whose own new comment narrated the fix -- reachable by any maintainer running --check with the real secret exported; scripts/lwb_check_lane_write.py's deny message still told a blocked agent to see docs/architecture.md for directive 5, the very citation this PR had just proved false in owner-directives.md while leaving the runtime-facing copy saying it; and docs/maintainers/proof-of-completion-plan.md claimed 'of ten distinct commands, five are re-executable and five are not' -- an arithmetic falsehood inside a document written to end false claims. ROUND 2 (e00520a) AGREE: the needle now reports as a stable 1-based index with no value on any path, proven by attacking _validate, cmd_check and cmd_write with synthetic needles and by confirming the two new tests FAIL against the pre-fix file extracted from b09d7d0 rather than passing vacuously; a repo-wide sweep found no third leak site; the lane-guard pointer now cites documents that genuinely carry directive 5; and the count was re-derived independently as ten distinct kinds at a five/three/two split. ROUND 3 (57c32c3) DISAGREE, narrow but exact: the regression test guarding the new vendor-drift fix was NON-DETERMINISTICALLY VACUOUS. filecmp.dircmp is shallow -- it calls two files equal when size and mtime match -- and the fixture did not force mtimes, so the reviewer ran it against the pre-fix implementation fifteen times and it caught the bug in only six. A guard that detects its own bug forty percent of the time could ship, run green on a fast runner, and never exercise what it names. The same round confirmed the production fix was sound: a same-length edit three directories deep with forced identical mtimes is correctly detected, and an end-to-end --check in a throwaway clone reports DRIFT for the tampered target and OK for the other. It also demonstrated two blind spots in the bytecode exemption -- a directory literally named __pycache__ holding real source, and a *.pyc file holding real source -- and judged them acceptable in a stdlib-only repo. ROUND 4, this record, on 7baafd3: the fixture now forces identical mtimes and sits three directories deep, and the reviewer re-ran the negative control at THIRTY trials rather than the fifteen claimed -- the pre-fix code wrongly reports equal 30/30, so the guard now fails deterministically against the code it guards. Fixture length verified by measurement at fourteen bytes on both sides rather than by eye; nesting verified as real, since no common file exists above pkg/sub/deeper so the recursion must descend three levels to compare anything. The accepted blind spots are recorded in the docstring and the reviewer judged the written justification conservative rather than overstated, having checked that _build_one's own ignore patterns keep such files out of a built tree entirely, so the only route to one is a hand-edit that bypasses the build script. pytest 177 passed 0 failed; lwb_build.py --check OK for both targets. THE UNDERLYING DEFECT THIS PR FIXES, for anyone reading later: scripts/lwb_build.py --check exists to stop a hand-edited vendor/ tree from shipping to a repo that installs this plugin, and it compared file sizes rather than contents, so a same-length edit -- warn to deny, a digit, a boolean -- passed it silently. NOT VERIFIED: GitHub-side CI status for this PR; the prior existence of two empty stray rules/rules/ directories claimed in an earlier commit message, which git cannot confirm or refute since nothing under that path was ever tracked and they are now deleted -- reported as unconfirmed rather than accepted; the env-leak history scan, which the reviewer cannot reproduce without the repository secret it does not hold and was instructed not to guess.
